component.name: Neutron Migrator
component.summary: Download or delete all your Proton Drive photos

description.p: Neutron Migrator scans your Proton Drive photo timeline, shows how many photos and how much space they take, and then downloads them to a folder you choose or deletes them (to the trash or permanently). Sign-in happens in your browser through the official Proton Drive CLI.
This is a third-party application, not officially supported by Proton AG.
